description: Fork of exp277 (same recipe: v_lut soft NAP=6, out_proj flat tph=2048, ffn_lut soft NAP=6 tph=256 E->E, residual_lut soft NAP=6 tph=256). One fix: ADD A SKIP CONNECTION around ffn_lut. ffn_out = out_e + ffn_lut(out_e), then ln_block_end on the sum. exp277 stalled (Delta +0.08 vs exp275 through 3600 steps) because ffn_lut sat on the critical path between out_proj and residual_lut with no bypass; at random init it destroyed signal. Skip lets ffn_lut behave as identity early. Param count unchanged (~199M).
